parsed.rationale: All eight members are unnamed extensions (name is empty string) on CGImage scattered across test files (ArtworkServiceTests.swift, ArtworkFetcherTests.swift, NowPlayingServiceTests.swift), a production source file (MultisourceArtworkService.swift), and an app-layer file (NowPlayingInfoCenterManager.swift) in three distinct packages (Artwork, AppServices, app:iOS). Because the cluster carries no fields_or_signature data and no shared_ancestor, jaccard, or differing_slots evidence, there is no structural basis to conclude these extensions share meaningful content rather than being independent, contextually appropriate extensions on the same Apple framework type. The 'name-collisions' query signal here reflects only that multiple files extend the same CGImage type, not that the extensions duplicate logic.
